feed.title: Business News - Markets reports and financial news from Sky

articles.title: Bugatti CEO chases down car thief - then offers him lift home
articles.summary: The head of the luxury car-maker Bugatti has promised to stop leaving his keys in his own car after his £2m model was stolen from a company site in Zagreb.

articles.title: Yorkshire Water boss resigns after company given lowest environmental rating
articles.summary: Yorkshire Water has announced its chief executive is stepping down - a day after the company was given the lowest environmental rating by regulators.

articles.title: Premier Inn-owner Whitbread wins investor backing in Corvex fight
articles.summary: The FTSE-100 owner of the Premier Inn hotel chain has won public backing from a top-25 shareholder as it tries to thwart an activist investor's boardroom raid.

articles.title: Poundland bidder tells administrator it remains keen on rescue deal
articles.summary: The Northern Irish company attempting to stage a solvent rescue of Poundland has told the discount retailer's administrator-in-waiting that it remains keen on a deal which could save more than 10,000 jobs.

articles.title: BP profits hit 18-year high as another bank makes billions
articles.summary: Profits at the UK-based oil and gas giant BP have hit an 18-year high, surpassing the level seen during the 2022 energy crisis.

articles.title: Crypto industry suffers 'largest bank heist in human history'
articles.summary: Cryptocurrency worth more than $6.3bn (£4.7bn) has been stolen from a major exchange - with one industry insider telling Sky News it is "the largest bank heist in human history".

articles.title: Why Google stock has plunged $500bn in a single day
articles.summary: Shares in Google's parent company Alphabet have suffered their worst-ever day on the US stock market, falling more than 12% and knocking around half a trillion dollars off its value.

articles.title: Will she stand? Lagarde quits European Central Bank ahead of French election
articles.summary: The French head of the European Central Bank (ECB) is to step down from the role, just months ahead of the troubled country's presidential election.

articles.title: Profits up billions at both UK's biggest mortgage provider and major oil producer
articles.summary: The UK's largest mortgage lender has seen profits nearly double as customers pay higher interest rates.

articles.title: Poundland closer to collapse as it files notice to appoint administrators
articles.summary: Poundland has filed notice to appoint administrators, bringing it one step closer to collapse.
